source.title: Making a museum visit accessible
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: The museum will take steps to make its public lectures easier to attend. Organisers need to identify barriers that prevent visitors from joining the discussion. They will ask participants about seating, sound and the timing of events before changing the programme. The report will separate observations from suggestions so that the committee can decide which changes to test first.
